name: Pipedrive
oneLiner: Sales-pipeline CRM billed per seat across four plans, with paid add-ons for lead capture, email marketing, web-visitor ID, projects and e-signatures.
summary: Pipedrive is a sales-pipeline CRM billed per seat across four plans (Lite, Growth, Premium and Ultimate), with the higher tiers adding built-in lead capture, workflow automation, e-signatures and data enrichment. On the two lower tiers, several of those same features (LeadBooster, Projects, Smart Docs) are only available as separate paid add-ons, and email marketing (Campaigns) plus website-visitor identification (Web Visitors) are paid add-ons on every plan, Ultimate included. Annual billing cuts the per-seat price by 20 to 42 percent depending on plan, and every plan includes a 14-day free trial with no credit card required.
notFor: Teams that want bulk email marketing or SMS included in the base subscription (email marketing costs extra on every plan; there is no SMS product at all)
Solo users on the Lite plan who need workflow automation or a synced email inbox (Lite has neither)
Businesses that want to know Web Visitors' real monthly cost before running a 7-day traffic sample
pros: 14-day free trial with full access and no credit card required
Pipedrive Nova meeting intelligence (call recording, transcripts, AI-drafted CRM updates) is included free on every plan, not sold as an add-on
Every plan bills strictly per seat with no minimum seat count, and annual billing cuts the per-seat price by 20-42%

Leads-and-deals capacity scales with seats (2,500 to 20,000 per seat depending on plan), not a single fixed number regardless of team size, though a 300,000 combined company-wide cap still applies on every plan
Plan limits and most add-on rates are published openly on the pricing page, including in a machine-readable format
cons: Lite and Growth lack built-in lead capture (LeadBooster), project management and e-signatures (Smart Docs); each is a separate paid add-on on those two plans
Lite has no workflow automation and no email sync at all; Growth's automation is capped at 50 active automations and just 5 nurture sequences company-wide
Email marketing (Campaigns) is a paid add-on on every plan, including Ultimate, priced by number of marketing subscribers held

Web Visitors' price above 2,000 identified organizations is not published and is only set after a 7-day traffic trial; Smart Docs' add-on price bands are labeled by an internal usage unit Pipedrive never defines
Annual plans are prepaid for the full year and non-refundable if cancelled
